children: U.S. cannabis operator's Q3 revenue rose 8.5% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA increased 18% sequentially, but net loss widened yr/yr
Growth driven by higher wholesale and retail sales, expanded branded product market share
MariMed says focus for Q4 and 2027 is on growing market share and opening new accounts
Company says it will monitor federal cannabis reform and possible tax and banking changes
BRANDED PRODUCT GROWTH - Co said increased market share of branded products, including Betty’s Eddies and other top-10 brands, contributed to revenue growth
RETAIL PERFORMANCE - Co said higher transactions and average order value at Thrive retail stores helped drive retail revenue growth
WHOLESALE PRICE PRESSURE - Co said year-over-year gross margin declined due to continued wholesale price compression
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the drug retailers peer group is "buy"
